high_level_description: The image captures a fashion show scene with a focus on the lower half of a model walking down the runway. The model is wearing a long, dark blue coat that drapes elegantly over their legs. They are also sporting beige high-top sneakers with the "Dior" logo prominently displayed on the side. The runway is made of light-colored wood, and the audience is seated on both sides, facing the model. The audience members are dressed in a variety of casual to semi-formal attire, including jeans, shorts, and blouses.
